headline: Executive order directing federal agencies to do more to advance racial equity and support underserved communities.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Biden, tells the federal government to keep working on racial equity and on helping communities that have been underserved. The word "Further" in the title suggests it builds on earlier federal efforts on the same topic. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, programs, or deadlines it sets cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are directed to take further steps on racial equity and support for underserved communities in their work.

who_it_affects.group: People in underserved communities, including racial minority groups
who_it_affects.how: These communities are the intended focus of the federal actions the order calls for.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 16, 2023; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
